column1: # s5b.tsv -- the mutations base#1851 (config-gen S5b, the tomllib oracle
# step and the verdict differential) requires script/test/mutation-probe.sh
# to report PINNED. One row per shell refusal guard of
# <id> TAB <subject> TAB <spec> TAB <old> TAB <new> TAB <witness>, the contract of
# once in <subject> and is replaced by <new> (empty <new> deletes), both
# written with the three escapes \\ \t \n. `just test mutation-required`
# probes every row and passes only when each one is PINNED.

column6: ^10-toml-oracle\.sh: a file name outside \[A-Za-z0-9\._/-\] is config_gen_toml_oracle_failed reason=name before any docker run, no toml-oracle/ left \(base#1851\)$
^10-toml-oracle\.sh: an image that cannot be provisioned is config_gen_toml_oracle_failed reason=image, no docker run, no toml-oracle/ left \(base#1851\)$
^10-toml-oracle\.sh: a container that exits non-zero is config_gen_toml_oracle_failed reason=image, no toml-oracle/ left \(base#1851\)$
^10-toml-oracle\.sh: an answer missing a row is config_gen_toml_oracle_failed reason=count, no toml-oracle/ left \(base#1851\)$
^10-toml-oracle\.sh: an answer whose verdict is neither accept nor refuse, or whose digest is not a SHA-256, is config_gen_toml_oracle_failed reason=token, no toml-oracle/ left \(base#1851\)$
